queue.title: What It Actually Takes to Gut a  Bathroom #tiles #demo #howtotile
queue.description:
SUBSCRIBE Learn how to tile the right way.
Dirty, Dusty Bathroom tear out, time lapse. Watch as I tear out this bathroom down to the studs, removing the sheetrock, wall tile, shower tile, ceiling tile, door frame and much more. This bathroom was completely gutted and made lightly bigger by reclaiming some waste space boxed in when the original install was done. All tile installed by Sal DiBlasi, Elite-tile Company, in the Boston North Shore area. draft.title: Complete Bathroom Demolition to Studs
draft.summary: This video shows the complete demolition of an old tiled bathroom, including removing fixtures, wall tiles, ceiling, and floor layers down to the bare studs.
draft.safety: Ensure water and electrical supplies are disconnected before using heavy tools around hidden pipes and wires.
steps: Disconnect plumbing connections and remove the sink and toilet fixtures.
Remove mirror cabinets and shower doors from walls.
Chisel away wall tiles and plaster using hand tools and pneumatic chisels.
Tear out shower enclosure walls, backing mortar, and ceiling materials.
Break up floor tile layers down to the subfloor boards.
Clean out all construction debris and inspect exposed framing studs.
